question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Submit true exactly when at least 2 nonempty ELF symbol names match /event_(success|decoy)/ and the final bytes do not contain NimMain. Submit lowercase true or false.
oracle_cmd: { [ $(readelf -sW gf_c_events.bin | sed -n '/Symbol table .\.symtab/,$p' | awk 'NR>2 && $8!=""{print $8}' | grep -cE 'event_(success|decoy)') -ge 2 ] && ! grep -q NimMain gf_c_events.bin; } && echo true || echo false
